## semantic_checks

```yaml
- id: KD-analyzer-teacher-provenance
  stage: stage_1_analyzer
  check: 'The spec records the teacher''s provenance: paper checkpoint, off-the-shelf
    model, or trained-from-scratch smoke substitute.

    '
  silent_failure: Downstream stages invent a teacher source and silently change the
    distillation target.
  severity: warning
  status: seed
- id: KD-seed-teacher-frozen
  stage: stage_2c_method
  check: The teacher is frozen (no grad updates to teacher params).
  silent_failure: Teacher params receive gradients; 'distillation' is just joint training.
  severity: error
  status: seed
- id: KD-arch-teacher-eval-frozen
  stage: stage_2b_architecture
  check: 'build_teacher returns a teacher in eval mode with every parameter frozen
    before the distillation loop can use it.

    '
  silent_failure: Batch-norm/dropout updates or gradients move the teacher while the
    method claims fixed-teacher KD.
  severity: error
  status: seed
- id: KD-method-loss-not-vanilla-fallback
  stage: stage_2c_method
  check: 'compute_distillation_loss implements the paper''s named KD components, not
    only vanilla softened-logit KL unless that is the paper''s actual contribution.

    '
  silent_failure: A complex feature/relation KD paper degenerates to Hinton-style
    KL and still runs.
  severity: error
  status: seed
- id: KD-det-analyzer-family-classified
  stage: stage_1_analyzer
  check: 'The spec identifies the detector family (DETR-style set prediction or CNN/grid-based
    detector) because it determines matching and feature-access requirements.

    '
  silent_failure: The coder picks an incompatible detector interface and loss alignment
    silently drifts.
  severity: warning
  status: seed
- id: KD-det-arch-query-access
  stage: stage_2b_architecture
  check: 'DETR-family detection KD exposes per-stage decoder outputs and teacher query
    embeddings when the paper''s loss consumes them.

    '
  silent_failure: Progressive or target-aware feature KD is reduced to final-layer
    logits only.
  severity: error
  status: seed
- id: KD-det-method-matching
  stage: stage_2c_method
  check: 'Set-prediction detector KD uses Hungarian or equivalent optimal assignment
    before comparing student and teacher predictions.

    '
  silent_failure: Top-k or index-aligned matching appears to work on smoke data while
    changing the loss.
  severity: error
  status: seed
- id: KD-xmodal-analyzer-modalities
  stage: stage_1_analyzer
  check: 'The spec names both student and teacher modalities and the shared representation
    where distillation aligns them.

    '
  silent_failure: The run is generated as same-modality detection KD and loses the
    cross-modal constraint.
  severity: error
  status: seed
- id: KD-xmodal-arch-shared-representation
  stage: stage_2b_architecture
  check: 'Student and teacher expose a matched shared-space feature accessor such
    as forward_with_bev_features.

    '
  silent_failure: The cross-modal loss cannot align features and collapses to output-response
    KD.
  severity: error
  status: seed
- id: KD-xmodal-method-paired-batches
  stage: stage_2c_method
  check: 'Batches preserve one-to-one pairing between student input, teacher input,
    and target annotations for the same scene.

    '
  silent_failure: Student and teacher observe different scenes, destroying the distillation
    signal silently.
  severity: error
  status: seed
```

## pluggable_component

```yaml
name: compute_distillation_loss
return_type: torch.Tensor
signature_template: compute_distillation_loss(student, teacher, batch, seed, *paradigm_extras_by_name)
  -> torch.Tensor
contract:
  fixed_positional_args:
  - student
  - teacher
  - batch
  seed_param: seed
  paradigm_extras_forwarding: by_name_from_config
  forbidden_param_names:
  - config
rationale: 'Cross-modal KD keeps the scalar KD loss shape while the batch dict and
  named extras carry paired modalities and shared-representation feature alignment.

  '
typical_paradigm_extras:
- name: temperature
  type: float
  default: 1.0
- name: alpha
  type: float
  default: 0.5
- name: bev_feature_weight
  type: float
  default: 1.0
- name: foreground_mask_weight
  type: float
  default: 1.0
- name: gaussian_sigma
  type: float
  default: 1.0
```

files:

      = 200, n_test: int = 50, seed: int = 0) -> Tuple[List[Image], List[Tensor],
      List[Dict], List[Image], List[Tensor], List[Dict]]'
- path: method/model.py
  kind: paradigm_shaped
  produced_by: architecture_coder
  public_symbols:
  - name: <StudentClass>
    kind: class
    inherits: torch.nn.Module
    required_methods:
    - 'forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]'
    - 'forward_with_bev_features(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> Tuple[Dict[str, torch.Tensor],
      torch.Tensor]'
  - name: <TeacherClass>
    kind: class
    inherits: torch.nn.Module
    required_methods:
    - 'forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]'
    - 'forward_with_bev_features(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> Tuple[Dict[str, torch.Tensor],
      torch.Tensor]'
- path: method/training.py
  kind: paradigm_fixed
  produced_by: architecture_coder
  public_symbols:
  - name: build_student
    kind: function
    signature: 'build_student(num_classes: int, **arch_kwargs) -> <StudentClass>'
  - name: build_teacher
    kind: function
    signature: 'build_teacher(num_classes: int, **arch_kwargs) -> <TeacherClass>'
  - name: train_with_distillation
    kind: function
    signature: 'train_with_distillation(student: <StudentClass>, teacher: <TeacherClass>,
      student_inputs_train: List[Image], teacher_inputs_train: List[Tensor], targets_train:
      List[Dict], *, distillation_loss_fn: Callable, learning_rate: float, num_epochs:
      int, batch_size: int, seed: int, **distillation_kwargs) -> <StudentClass>'
- path: method/method.py
  kind: method_shaped
  produced_by: method_coder
  public_symbols:
  - name: compute_distillation_loss
    kind: function
    signature: compute_distillation_loss(student, teacher, batch, seed, *paradigm_extras_by_name)
      -> torch.Tensor
    contract:
      fixed_positional_args:
      - student
      - teacher
      - batch
      seed_param: seed
      paradigm_extras_forwarding: by_name_from_config
      forbidden_param_names:

  - name: <method_helpers>
    kind: function
    all_top_level_functions_are_public: true
dependency_graph:

  - method/data.py
  - method/method.py
  - method/model.py
  - method/training.py
validators:

  after_method_coder: scripts/validate_method_coder_output.py
  after_init_finalizer:

  - scripts/validate_arch_contract_runtime.py
